name: corpse_kept_seen
about: An ordinary mortal's corpse the player is looking at is not removed. The damage_lethal_death staging (an idle TutorialThug on the east pad, TakeDamage 10000 at 3 s), the player at the start facing the east pad. CBaseCombatCharacter::CreateCorpse 0x1032c0e0's tail arms SUB_PVSRemove 0x102696f0 at curtime + 10.0 (0x1032c404) on an ordinary mortal's corpse; the think re-arms itself every 10 s while any player passes all three of the view cone (slot 363 FInViewCone), the PVS test (0x101d1a90) and FVisible(corpse, mask 0x2804091) (slot 201), and otherwise calls UTIL_Remove 0x101cd940 (stories/v4/packets-S1.md item 1; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J13). Seen at the think of death + 10 s, the corpse re-arms and stays: no `removed` event through death + 12 s, and the entity still answers its name.
notes: The second half of corpse_removed_unseen (brief A0 item 7b: 'a second record ... facing the corpse'). Death at 3.0-3.1 s; the record runs through death + 12 s. GREEN on the V4a seam's build: the corpse think reads the player's view through the embodiment, not slot 363.
